No Composio toolkit exists for Mermaid CLI specifically (Composio's mermaid_chart_mcp targets the separate commercial SaaS product Mermaid Chart).
primary_blocker: Not a hosted SaaS API; requires executing a local Node.js/Puppeteer process or Docker container with headless Chromium, which adds container/sandbox overhead and Linux Chromium configuration issues in serverless or multi-tenant environments.
commercial_considerations: MIT-licensed open-source software with zero licensing fees; only self-hosting/compute infrastructure costs apply.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_line_description: Unofficial Python library (youtube-transcript-api) and third-party transcript wrappers for fetching YouTube captions, contrasting with Google's official YouTube Data API v3 captions endpoint which only allows downloading captions for videos you own.
api_breadth_basis: Single-purpose transcript/subtitle retrieval and translation per video ID via the unofficial youtube-transcript-api Python library (no API key required); Google's official YouTube Data API v3 captions.download REST endpoint requires OAuth 2.0 and edit permission on the video. Composio's youtube_transcript toolkit exposes 9 tools over a third-party REST API.
mcp_details: No official Google/YouTube Transcript MCP server exists. Composio provides a youtube_transcript toolkit (https://docs.composio.dev/toolkits/youtube_transcript, API Key auth, 9 tools). Numerous community MCP servers wrap youtube-transcript-api (e.g., github.com/jkawamoto/mcp-youtube-transcript).
primary_blocker: YouTube provides no official public API to download transcripts for arbitrary third-party videos (YouTube Data API v3 captions.download requires edit permissions on the target video), forcing reliance on unofficial scraping libraries (prone to cloud IP blocking/breakage) or paid third-party wrapper APIs.
commercial_considerations: Unofficial youtube-transcript-api is MIT-licensed and free but may require proxy infrastructure in production and carries YouTube ToS/reliability risks; managed third-party APIs incur per-request/subscription costs.

name: Grain
one_line_description: AI meeting recording, transcription, and sales/team intelligence platform with a date-versioned Public REST API v2, webhooks, and an official hosted OAuth MCP server.
api_breadth_basis: Date-versioned Public API v2 (https://api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2) covering recordings (list, get, transcripts in JSON/TXT/VTT/SRT, download, upload, title/tags/sharing), highlights, webhooks (10 event types), and workspace metadata at 300 req/min; official hosted MCP server additionally exposes AI semantic search, deal health, coaching scorecards, and clip creation.
mcp_details: Official hosted Grain MCP Server documented at https://developers.grain.com/mcp/ (available on every Grain plan via OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration). Composio also provides a grain toolkit (https://composio.dev/toolkits/grain/framework/claude-cowork).
primary_blocker: Capabilities are split across surfaces: AI semantic search, deal health, and coaching scorecards live in Grain's hosted MCP server rather than the REST API, while webhooks, uploads, and downloads live in the REST API (requiring dual auth management if both are needed).
commercial_considerations: Personal Access Tokens (PATs) and the official hosted MCP server are self-service across Grain plans; Workspace Access Tokens (WATs), team-wide sharing, coaching scorecards, and CRM integrations depend on paid Grain team/business tiers.
